gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Autour One builds its round letters from strips of uniform width, expressive and free of any thin-to-thick shifts. Below it, Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic points its c ends apart like pincers.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Expressive Autour One writes with a fixed-width stencil brush line. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian carries paragraphs cleanly after that, big open eyes in every e and a and a deep middle band keeping lines legible.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-jp: Round and unshaded, Autour One keeps every curve free of stress, bold and expressive. Noto Sans JP brings curves that sweep open over a very large x-height, the single feature that lifts the pair.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi lets its lowercase fill the line almost like capitals, with an open channel running through each e. Autour One's ballpoint-pen stroke leads, expressive where the body stays quiet.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Punchy and blunt: Autour One gives diagonals the same weight as horizontals, while Noto Sans Limbu gapes open in its curves. That big-bodied lowercase is the single thread tying the two.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani stands out with lowercase that rises close to the capitals and a funnel-wide throat in the e. Noto Sans Mahajani gives Autour One's wire-like, gliding heading a modern sans-serif partner.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Expressive Autour One writes like a stylus held at fixed pressure. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, a contemporary sans, keeps a visibly gaping c at any size, so long paragraphs stay open and easy to move through.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mende-kik: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets visible daylight through every curved opening, and its lowercase rises close to the capitals. Autour One's single, unvarying stroke width is the sharpest difference between them.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mono: Contemporary Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters so none ever bump. Against Autour One's ballpoint-pen stroke, that generous spacing and those wide curve openings are the quality that carries the pair.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense through the middle of each word, yet its large entrances let the letters breathe. Autour One's tubing-like strokes lead, and the body fills in behind.
